claim: The sample seed can be played through all three stops to a win.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; play visible intents until the win summary

claim: A lost run reaches an end screen and restart restores the opening state.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; hold position to lose; restart; assert turn, integrity and intent reset

claim: Every dated seed has a safe route through three stops.
sandbox: deterministic engine; play the safe Fire route for all 108 possible car-order, enemy-family-order, and weather configurations that a dated seed can select

claim: The sample run never changes daily progress.
sandbox: seed daily storage; change and reset demo; assert daily storage is byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: Playing a run sends no game or personal data off the product origin.
sandbox: record all requests for a demo action and settings change; require the product origin only

claim: The daily game reloads offline after one online visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; claim service worker control; go offline; reload and take a turn

claim: The board and turn actions work with a keyboard.
sandbox: fresh demo; focus board; use arrows and B; assert one resolved turn and focus remains usable

claim: The current daily run resumes after a reload.
sandbox: fresh daily run; resolve one turn; reload; assert seed, turn, train health and log are preserved

claim: Board coordinate settings persist in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context; hide coordinates; reload; assert coordinate labels stay hidden

claim: Invalid board choices do not use a turn.
sandbox: fresh sample; choose an empty cell and a full car; assert the turn stays at one and an explanation is announced

claim: Dated seeds vary the car order, enemy families, and final weather.
sandbox: generate 40 dated configurations; require multiple car orders, family orders, and all three weather rules

claim: Purchase and archive activation are unavailable until the offer is registered.
sandbox: fresh browser; open archive and license routes; require disabled purchase state, pending explanation, and no checkout request
